metadata.description: HR-initiated org transfer and compensation change with staged approvals, integration writes, and saga repair handling.

uxContract.title: Employee org transfer and compensation change

errorMessages.permissionDenied: You do not have the required org-transfer scope for this action.
errorMessages.versionConflict: This workflow changed. Refresh before submitting again.
errorMessages.repairRequired: The transfer needs HR repair before it can continue.

sourceManagerApproval.title: Source manager approval
sourceManagerApproval.summaryTemplate: Review the transfer out of the current team and manager scope.

destinationManagerApproval.title: Destination manager approval
destinationManagerApproval.summaryTemplate: Review the proposed destination manager, team, and work location.

financeApproval.title: Finance cost-center approval
financeApproval.summaryTemplate: Review the target cost center and cross-charge impact.

compensationApproval.title: Compensation approval
compensationApproval.summaryTemplate: Review the proposed compensation with job and org context.

medicalDirectorApproval.title: Medical director clinical placement approval
medicalDirectorApproval.summaryTemplate: Review clinical placement scope for the target clinic.

readyToExecute.title: Ready to execute org transfer
readyToExecute.summaryTemplate: All required approvals are complete. Execution will update assignments, role bindings, employee projection, payroll, HRIS, and compensation vendor sync.

completedSummary.title: Org transfer completed
completedSummary.summaryTemplate: The employee's destination org placement, manager, job, compensation, assignments, and access bindings were updated.

nodes.title: Org transfer workflow waiting for repair

futureParallelUpgradePath.description: Source manager, destination manager, finance, compensation, and medical director approvals are serial in V1. The approval sequence can later be replaced by a parallel_split after source manager approval and a parallel_join before ready_to_execute once runtime join semantics are available.

summaries.WorkflowIntentStarted: Org transfer and compensation workflow started.
